title: TikTok’s 2026 forecast: emotional ROI is replacing impulse buying
discussion_signal: The TikTok Next discussion frames platform culture around grounded authenticity, curiosity-led discovery, community conversation, and purchases justified by emotional value rather than impulse alone.
linked_research_question: How does TikTok’s forecast move users from passive scrolling toward grounded reality, curiosity-led discovery, community verification, and more intentional purchases?
limits: The post is platform marketing and trend interpretation
It does not provide independent user-behaviour data
Commercial language may overstate intentionality and understate platform incentive structures
